title: Scheduled nbn software update – Victoria
current_summary:
Affects some nbn services in the Albury, Corowa and Wahgunyah area. The maintenance window is 12:00am to 6:00am on Tuesday 27 October 2026 (AEDT), with a service interruption of up to 60 minutes from 12:30am.

This deployment will provide an enhanced remote service test capability to support nbn network and service assurance testing. Test and Diagnostics will be unavailable during the planned work. Works are being undertaken overnight to minimise disruption to customers.

nbn® is completing a remote software update on your nbn-branded equipment. This will cause your nbn service to briefly lose connection. 
If your connection does not come back after the listed outage date and times, try turning your nbn connection box off at the power point, waiting 30 seconds, then switching it on again.

cause.reason: Planned remote software update to nbn network equipment.

updates.content:
Affects some nbn services in Victoria. The maintenance window is 12:00am to 6:00am on Tuesday 27 October 2026 (AEDT), with a service interruption of up to 60 minutes scheduled from 12:30am.

This deployment will provide an enhanced remote service test capability to support nbn network and service assurance testing. Test and Diagnostics will be unavailable during the planned work. Works are being undertaken overnight to minimise disruption to customers.

nbn® is completing a remote software update on your nbn-branded equipment. This will cause your nbn service to briefly lose connection. 
If your connection does not come back after the listed outage date and times, try turning your nbn connection box off at the power point, waiting 30 seconds, then switching it on again.
The planned maintenance has started. The service interruption of up to 60 minutes is still scheduled from 12:30am AEDT, within the window ending 6:00am.
